verse.unicode: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧

transliteration.english: raag soohee mahalaa chauthhaa chha(n)t ghar pehilaa

en.bdb: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Chhant, First House:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: satigur purakh milai avagan vikanaa gun ravaa bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: If only I could meet the True Guru, the Primal Being. Discarding my faults and sins, I would chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: har har naam dhiaai gurbaanee nit nit chavaa bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Continuously, continually, I chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: gurbaanee sadh meeThee laagee paap vikaar gavaiaa ||

en.bdb: Gurbani always seems so sweet; I have eradicated the sins from within.

verse.unicode: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: haumai rog giaa bhau bhaagaa sahaje sahaj milaiaa ||

en.bdb: The disease of egotism is gone, fear has left, and I am absorbed in celestial peace.

verse.unicode: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗੋ ॥

transliteration.english: kaiaa sej gur sabadh sukhaalee giaan tat kar bhogo ||

en.bdb: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the bed of my body has become cozy and beautiful, and I enjoy the essence of spiritual wisdom.

verse.unicode: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: anadhin sukh maane nit raleeaa naanak dhur sa(n)jogo ||1||

en.bdb: Night and day, I continually enjoy peace and pleasure. O Nanak, this is my pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਕੁੜਮੁ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau kuRam kuRamaiee aaiaa bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: The soul-bride is lovingly embellished with truth and contentment; her Father, the Guru, has come to engage her in marriage to her Husband Lord.

verse.unicode: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: sa(n)t janaa kar mel gurbaanee gaavaieeaa bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: Joining with the humble Saints, I sing Gurbani.

verse.unicode: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: baanee gur gaiee param gat paiee pa(n)ch mile sohaiaa ||

en.bdb: Singing the Guru's Bani, I have obtained the supreme status; meeting with the Saints, the self-elect, I am blessed and adorned.

verse.unicode: ਗਇਆ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: giaa karodh mamataa tan naaThee paakha(n)dd bharam gavaiaa ||

en.bdb: Anger and attachment have left my body and run away; I have eradicated hypocrisy and doubt.

verse.unicode: ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: haumai peer giee sukh paiaa aarogat bhe sareeraa ||

en.bdb: The pain of egotism is gone, and I have found peace; my body has become healthy and free of disease.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: gur parasaadhee braham pachhaataa naanak gunee gaheeraa ||2||

en.bdb: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I have realized God, the ocean of virtue. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: manmukh vichhuRee dhoor mahal na paae bal giee bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: The self-willed manmukh is separated, far away from God; she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence, and she burns.

verse.unicode: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੂਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: a(n)tar mamataa koor kooR vihaajhe kooR liee bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: Egotism and falsehood are deep within her; deluded by falsehood, she deals only in falsehood.

verse.unicode: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: kooR kapaT kamaavai mahaa dhukh paavai vin satigur mag na paiaa ||

en.bdb: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.

verse.unicode: ਉਝੜ ਪੰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: aujhaR pa(n)th bhramai gaavaaree khin khin dhake khaiaa ||

en.bdb: The foolish soul-bride wanders along dismal pathways; each and every moment, she is bumped and pushed.

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥

transliteration.english: aape dhiaa kare prabh dhaataa satigur purakh milaae ||

en.bdb: God, the Great Giver, shows His Mercy, and leads her to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

verse.unicode: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: janam janam ke vichhuRe jan mele naanak sahaj subhaae ||3||

en.bdb: Those beings who have been separated for countless incarnations, O Nanak, are reunited with the Lord, with intuitive ease. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਆਇਆ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: aaiaa lagan ganai hiradhai dhan omaaheeaa bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: Calculating the most auspicious moment, the Lord comes into the bride's home; her heart is filled with ecstasy.

verse.unicode: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਆਣਿ ਪਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: pa(n)ddit paadhe aan patee beh vaachaieeaa bal raam jeeau ||

en.bdb: The Pandits and astrologers have come, to sit and consult the almanacs.

verse.unicode: ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥

transliteration.english: patee vaachaiee man vajee vadhaiee jab saajan sune ghar aae ||

en.bdb: They have consulted the almanacs, and the bride's mind vibrates with bliss, when she hears that her Friend is coming into the home of her heart.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਹਿ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥

transliteration.english: gunee giaanee beh mataa pakaiaa fere tat dhivaae ||

en.bdb: The virtuous and wise men sat down and decided to perform the marriage immediately.

verse.unicode: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: var paiaa purakh aga(n)m agochar sadh navatan baal sakhaiee ||

en.bdb: She has found her Husband, the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Primal Lord, who is forever young; He is her Best Friend from her earliest childhood.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak kirapaa kar kai mele vichhuR kadhe na jaiee ||4||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, he has mercifully united the bride with Himself. She shall never be separated again. ||4||1||
